verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's marketplace lets users filter offers by GPU type. The homepage announces NVIDIA GB200s (current-generation Blackwell datacenter class) for rent. Community and runtime evidence show cheaper previous-generation options available alongside, such as A100 PCIe at about $0.79/hr, RTX 3090 and live RTX 4090 offers. missing for 10: no explicit evidence of H100/H200/B200 SKUs in listings, no documented catalog of datacenter GPU generations, and no independent hands-on confirmation of current-gen datacenter availability or stock.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: NVIDIA GB200s are now available. Rent GB200s
filter for various criteria (location, GPU type and count, various hardware specs, rental params, etc)
returning real RTX 4090 offers with CUDA versions, vCPUs, RAM, disk, and per-hour prices
